Core Active Vocabulary (10 items):

open — to move something so it is not closed. Example: Open the window, please.
close — to shut something. Example: Close the door, please.
sit down — to move to a sitting position. Example: Sit down, please.
stand up — to move to a standing position. Example: Stand up, please.
listen — to pay attention to sound. Example: Listen and repeat.
look — to turn your eyes to something. Example: Look at the board.
repeat — to say something again. Example: Listen and repeat.
write — to make words with a pen. Example: Write your name.
read — to look at words and understand them. Example: Read the text.
stop — to finish an action. Example: Stop writing, please.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• Open your books, please.
• Listen and repeat.
• Stand up.
• Don't write in the book.
• Look at the board.
